summary: The audit checks ARTHIST 405A, taken for a letter grade, and 135 graduate units. Collaterals (three outside courses, two if you entered with an M.A.) and one course in each of the five distribution areas of your track have no course lists, so you move the approved courses in. The Film & Media Studies subplan is optional and needs an approved petition. The 3.0 GPA (with a B+ or better expected in each course), the qualifying exam, teaching, candidacy, colloquia, proposal, oral defense, dissertation and the language requirement are checked by hand.

iNshZyQO.why: "Collaterals are courses offered outside the Art & Art History Department ... Students entering with a B.A. must take a minimum of three collateral courses. Those entering with an M.A. must take a minimum of two collateral courses." "Students must consult with their primary advisor about their choice of collateral courses" and "Courses cross-listed with ARTHIST or FILMEDIA do not fulfill this requirement." Set to three; an M.A. entrant marks it done after two.

wKUer7uM.why: "Students must take at least one course in each of the five distribution areas." (in either the Art History or the Film & Media Studies track) and "All courses must be taught by different faculty members." The areas have no course lists.

QIIvECJM.why: Grading: "Graduate students in the department must take required courses for letter grades if this option is available"

aD7tALVa.why: "Students may petition for the sub-plan designation, either on the basis of their coursework or the focus of the dissertation." The subplan is optional (the Bulletin does not require one), and choosing it means the petition.

patch.name: Petition approved for the Film & Media Studies subplan

nQcxXKNd.why: "Graduate students must demonstrate proficiency in one language relevant to their field of study." A requirement, not an overview, so its section counts.
